description: This file contains test cases implemented using the Vitest testing framework for verifying the behavior of shell command analysis and wrapper resolution functions related to exec approvals, involving fixtures loaded from helper functions.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for exec approvals shell parser parity fixture and wrapper resolution parity fixture.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Performs assertions within individual test cases to verify function outputs against expected results.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases that iterate over fixture data to validate shell command parsing and resolution logic.

methods.name: loadShellParserParityFixtureCases
methods.description: Loads test fixture data for shell parser parity tests.

methods.name: loadWrapperResolutionParityFixtureCases
methods.description: Loads test fixture data for wrapper resolution parity tests.

methods.name: analyzeShellCommand
methods.description: Analyzes a given shell command and returns an object with parsing results.

methods.name: resolveCommandResolutionFromArgv
methods.description: Resolves command execution details from command-line argument vector (argv).
